lines: Mahomes has thrown 35.7 passes per game over his last 3, up from 33.1 for the season, and scored 25.8 PPR points per game.
Week 11 is against ARI, who allow the 2nd-most PPR points per game to quarterbacks. KC's implied team total is 29.0 points.
Andy Reid said Mahomes is staying in the pocket more but will still scramble when needed. He has 20 total TDs this season.
